phase: UI20 baseline audit for UI21 remediation
scope: All 99 runtime catalog entries, including class features and wild forms. Static code-path review, not proof that every full gameplay cast was executed.

priority_scale.1: Missing emitted/recognizable effect, invisible live state or misleading geometry; address first
priority_scale.2: Generic effect or weak distinction; preserve exact geometry and gameplay
priority_scale.3: Existing suitable baseline or intentionally no spell animation
